about: JSON files as Read-ChatqJson (src/queue.ps1) reads them under each PowerShell - Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json, then return - and whether the read needed a repair (SPEC 2.2). input: the file as bytes (hex), as text written as UTF-8, or as pretty: text exactly as chatqd's writer (json::to_pretty) writes it. expect: {value, repaired}; value is null where Read-ChatqJson returns $null, objects keep their order, a [datetime] is {date: its 'o' in Korea Standard Time}. Cases by an edition are files its Save-ChatqJson (ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8) wrote.
